The topic of **Evaluation** in the provided corpus centers on the assessment of organizational development goals and performance metrics. Currently, the evidence for this topic is limited to a single specific evaluation regarding [[indikator-2|Indikator 2]]. According to the documentation, the evaluation concluded that the development target of reaching 90% or higher was not achieved [^src1]. This finding highlights a transparent reporting mechanism where shortfalls in specific performance indicators are explicitly documented and tracked. Because the available data is thin, no further evaluative findings, chronological trends, or additional indicators are detailed in the provided sources.

## Claims

- Udviklingsmålet på ≥ 90 % var således ikke opnået [^src1] (indikator-2)
